many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

    """Tile the input 3 times vertically and 2 times horizontally,
    reflecting across each tile boundary."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for y in range(3 * h):
        band = y // h
        sy0 = y % h
        sy = h - 1 - sy0 if band in (0, 2) else sy0
        row = []
        for x in range(2 * w):
            block = x // w
            sx0 = x % w
            sx = w - 1 - sx0 if block == 0 else sx0
            row.append(grid[sy][sx])
        out.append(row)
    return out
